deviations: analysis_data.dta is not shipped; it was rebuilt in R from the 01_base files following 2_Data_Construction.do, keeping only the variables the targeted tables use (fliers, stratum, randomization schedule incl. the a7 654 fix, registration, tax roll, midline, TDM payments; Stata merge semantics with master values winning on overlapping variables; carto-date imputations and today_alt as in the do-file). The pilot flier xlsx sets, chefferies and 2016 assignment merges were skipped because they only touch pilot polygons (dropped) or variables not used.
Coefficients only are reported; fixest clustered SEs (by a7) use fixest's small-sample defaults, which can differ marginally from Stata reg, cl().
notes: Attempt-1 was an exploratory run (column names/structure, no estimates). The single scored run reproduces Table 4 exactly (N 28,872 / 27,764 / 23,803; clusters 221 / 213; Central means 0.068 / 0.063), Table 7 cols 1-2 (N 20,636, 165 clusters) and Table 8 Panel A col 2 (N 8,135). Table 6 col 1 gives -0.0088 with N 18,152 (paper 18,162). Table 5 Panel B paid bribe (endline) gives 0.0173 with N 1,178 (paper 0.018, N 1,169); the small sample gap was not chased. No claim-driven changes were made. The host was awake, so no runs hung.
